observable_outcome: This Foundation Repository has been dogfooded as a Preview target at the preview-local grade on the owner's own machine: a real cmd/control-plane process on 127.0.0.1, a real Firestore emulator, a real enrolled Runner session over real HTTP, and the real claude CLI as a real child process group. All twelve Release Contract capabilities were attempted one by one against their own declared success condition and declared external dependencies. Three (cap-requirement-intake, cap-backlog-visibility, cap-user-documentation) were observed succeeding in full and now carry an evidence id in contracts/release-contract/foundation.json, which required moving the release off the machine-enforced unexercised baseline 0.1.0-baseline to 0.1.0-preview.1. The other nine carry an empty evidence_ids and a named attribution: four to the initial deploy gate D1 because they declare Google Cloud Run, two to a later milestone, and five to escalations E22-1 through E22-5 whose observable result has no implementation, so no deploy would fix them. The Preview was broken on purpose: two real signed builds were installed through internal/update, the preview channel was pointed at a deliberately defective build applied only to a copy of the tree in t.TempDir(), the failure and the refused Runner claim were observed over real HTTP, the channel was rolled back to the previously verified version, and the Requirement captured before the break was still in the same emulator canonical state and reached a terminal state under the restored build with a real claude invocation. No Stable release was promoted or faked: docs/stable/index.md still reads Stable release: none, all twelve statuses stay preview, and the real-tree candidate is still refused, but the refusal set is now the measured nine rather than a blanket twelve, and a hermetic positive control built from the run's own digests proves the gate promotes when the evidence is real.
acceptance_criteria: A1. State each measurement with the command used.

If .agents/v2/packets/provider-standing-authorization.json is absent, or its scope does not cover claude, stop and escalate rather than authoring an approval.

A3. The live exercise is one new file, internal/api/live_dogfood_test.go, package api_test, one top-level test TestFoundationPreviewLocalDogfood composed of ordered subtests named exactly after what they exercise (cap-<capability-id> for the twelve capability exercises, plus channel-break-and-resume, promotability-negative, promotability-positive, environment-identifiers and ledger-snapshot). A4. The gate behaves as follows and this is proven, not asserted. With AGENTIC_LOOP_LIVE_DOGFOOD unset the test logs the unmet condition with t.Logf and calls t.Skip, so devbox run --pure -- make check starts zero processes and makes zero provider invocations; measure the V2-022 ledger's entry count immediately before and immediately after one make check run and report both numbers. Every live run's verdict must record a skip count of zero for the subtests it claims; a skipped subtest is never reported as passed.

Every capability check in both evidence records carries the release-contract.md section 3 identifiers, obtained in the same session as the run: environment class preview-local; the machine identifier from `hostname` and `uname -sr`; the emulator name, the `firebase --version` output, the project agentic-loop-test and the actual 127.0.0.1:<port> host; the claude CLI's absolute path and `--version` output; the Go toolchain version; and for every real invocation the CLI-issued session_id. constraints: The Preview environment is preview-local as defined in docs/architecture/release-contract.md section 3: the owner's own machine, real processes, the real claude CLI and a Firestore emulator. This is not a substitute for a real environment; gate rule G3-2 makes it the real environment for conditions about the Loop's own observable behaviour. Do not deploy anything, do not touch a GCP project, do not create a Cloud Run service, do not enable IAP, and do not connect to a real Firestore.

The four conditions deferred to the initial deploy gate D1 (V2-054) are out of scope and must never be asserted here: the IAP authentication boundary, idle scale-to-zero, real Firestore permissions and contention, and the approved-plan-digest deploy path. A capability whose declared external systems include Google Cloud Run cannot receive an evidence id in this task no matter how well its local behaviour is observed.

Do not fabricate capability evidence, and do not weaken a contract declaration to make a result fit it. contracts/release-contract/foundation-capabilities.json's capability declarations, including every preview_exercise and outcome_conditions value, must stay byte-identical apart from the three release-identity fields of A14. If a declared success condition cannot be observed, the honest record is a failed check and an empty evidence_ids, not an edited declaration.

The retry budget for this task is 2 attempts. Escalate to tech_lead rather than guessing: any capability whose eligibility under dp-v2-022 d2 is unclear, any second consecutive failure of the same acceptance item, any need to touch a prohibited path, and any suggestion that a capability should be promoted to status stable.

The ten escalations E22-1 through E22-10 recorded in dp-v2-022 d18 must not be decided inside this task. Five of them are the reason nine capabilities cannot be exercised: E22-1 no Repository registration, Git or GitHub; E22-2 no needs-input question surface; E22-3 internal/release is unwired, which is V2-021's E2; E22-4 no Provider status surface; E22-5 internal/scheduler is unwired and no control mode sets a limit. Two bound what the evidence may claim: E22-6 cmd/runner has no control-plane wiring; E22-9 the live test's imports exceed the api component's declared dependency edges. Three are measured shortfalls: E22-7 no Repository filter on the Backlog; E22-8 no Runner, process or lease projection in the control read model; E22-10 the owner console serves no document route. Report them; do not fix them, and do not edit ci/components.json to make E22-9 go away.

Provider usage is governed by the A2 preflight record and by the owner's standing authorization psa-foundation-001. The count and the money figures are runaway-detection thresholds, not an approval question and not a billing budget; reaching one is a fail-closed stop for inspection that is neither success nor failure. Never raise a limit in place, never reinitialise the ledger, never clear halted, and never edit the ledger file. The remedy is a new owner-issued record with a new id and, if needed, a new ledger path.

Secrets and identifiers: pass only the minimum environment the record declares (HOME and PATH); environment.granted_names stays empty because the claude CLI reads its own credential store. Record provider, version, capability, time, result, consumption and the provider-issued session_id only. Never record a prompt, a raw response, an excerpt of a response, or any credential value, in a test file, a document, an evidence record or a commit message. Keep the word for metered units out of summaries by writing input, output, cache-read and cache-creation counts.

Do not create cost, notification or public exposure outside the declared test resources. The complete side-effect surface is: the claude CLI's own endpoint reached by the CLI itself, the V2-022 cost ledger outside the repository, the script-managed Firestore emulator, and channel roots, installed versions and workspaces under t.TempDir(). No GitHub object, no Issue, no comment, no push to any remote, no webhook and no email.

Determinism is an acceptance property. No fixed sleep, no wall-clock dependence, no background timer, no goroutine of the test's own, and no dependence on another test's execution order; use t.TempDir(), bounded readiness polling on an observable condition, and a per-subtest context deadline that fails rather than hangs. A sub-exercise that cannot be made deterministic must be escalated, not retried into a pass: validation.md section 9 forbids promoting a result that varied.

Do not write any file under .agents/v2/task-state/. Sol owns every task-state transition and the coordinator edits that directory concurrently. Report the exact block_reason string instead, using the external-unavailable prefix when the environment could not run a verification at all.
